title: Sulfur Cubes Keep Effects & Eat Everything
description: Makes sulfur cubes with blocks keep some effects. Adds a potion to clear effects. Sulfur cubes are able to eat far more blocks.
body:
# Sulfur Cubes Keep Effects & More 🧪🍴

## Sulfur Keeps Effects 🧪
Sulfur cubes retain some effects with a block, Invisibility, Levitation, and Slow falling, particles are hidden. Adds new equipment a potion that remove effects.

### Adds:
- Potion of Nullification.
- Sulfur Cubes with block keep Invisibility, Levitation, and Slow falling.
  
### Notes:
- Potion of Nullification is a potion, glowstone dust, honeycomb, and fermented spider eye.


## Sulfur Cubes Eat More Things 🍴
Sulfur cubes can eat things that aren't full blocks, like repeaters, banners, and even powdered snow.

### Adds:
- Sulfur Cubes ability to eat almost everything.
  
### Notes:
- Some blocks are glitched, including glass, and honey.

![A sulfur cube with a mace head should be here.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d184c332285dc0998dc51e9312d64fc74cb5d71a_0.webp)


## Updates
- V 1.4 Adds sulfur cube scaling with bonemeal to scale up, and spider eyes or fermented spider eyes to scale downwards. Echo shards cause the sulfur cube to become silent. Adds two new achievements for this. Bonemeals add 100% base scale. Spider eyes subtract 25% base scale, and fermented spider eyes subtract 50% base scale. All of these effects stack with each other
but can be applied only once, a bucket resets the scaling effects.
  
- V 1.5 Added blocks which were originally over-looked, being the redstone block and the sand variants.
  
- V 1.6 Adds support for the two new archetypes, in addition to moving which archetypes some items fell under, due to the addition of the new archetypes.


## Notes
- New Updates won't be added until 26.3 due to it making downloading non-snapshot versions more difficult.
